description: This file defines the CountThings command class, which is used to construct and handle commands for counting 'things' within a system. It includes methods for creating instances, serializing to and deserializing from JSON, and managing command-specific parameters like 'filter' and 'namespaces'.

classes.name: CountThings
classes.description: A command class for counting 'things', supporting filtering and namespace selection, immutable and serializable to/from JSON, extending AbstractCommand.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CountThings command with specified filter, namespaces, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CountThings instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the optional set of namespace strings.

methods.name: setNamespaces
methods.description: Returns a new CountThings instance with the provided namespaces.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command parameters into a JSON payload.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new CountThings instance with the specified headers.
